definitions.gloss: to use for two or more purposes; to serve double duty; to share between uses
definitions.explanation: To use a single item or space for multiple functions rather than having separate ones for each purpose.

examples.japanese: ⟦リビング→リビング：11198_ribingu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書斎|しょさい}→書斎：03760_shosai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{兼用|けんよう}する。
examples.english: To use the living room as a study as well.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{晴雨|せいう}{兼用|けんよう}→晴雨兼用：28591_seiukenyou⟧だ。
examples.english: This umbrella serves for both sun and rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{兼用|けんよう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{順番待|じゅんばんま}ち→順番待ち：09747_junbanmachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The whole family shares one computer, so sometimes we have to take turns.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb from ⟦{兼用|けんよう}→兼用：15781_kenyou⟧, composed of {兼|けん} (to combine, to serve concurrently) + ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (use). Often used as a noun modifier without ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: ⟦{兼用|けんよう}→兼用：15781_kenyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (dual-purpose).

USAGE:
Very common in product descriptions and everyday conversation about shared or multi-purpose items. The noun form ⟦{兼用|けんよう}→兼用：15781_kenyou⟧ is often used directly: A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兼用|けんよう}→兼用：15781_kenyou⟧ (serving as both A and B).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{晴雨|せいう}{兼用|けんよう}→晴雨兼用：28591_seiukenyou⟧ — for both sun and rain (umbrellas)
- ⟦{男女|だんじょ}→男女：03117_danjo⟧⟦{兼用|けんよう}→兼用：15781_kenyou⟧ — unisex
- ⟦{兼用|けんよう}→兼用：15781_kenyou⟧⟦スペース→スペース：11049_supeesu⟧ — shared/multi-purpose space
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{兼用|けんよう}する — to use something as both A and B

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{共用|きょうよう}→共用：21529_kyouyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to share (among people; focus on joint access)
- ⟦{併用|へいよう}→併用：11558_heiyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to use together, to use concurrently (two things used simultaneously)
- ⟦{流用|りゅうよう}→流用：13393_ryuuyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to divert, to repurpose (redirecting something from its original use)
